metaTitle: TextVerified Alternative — SMS Code App by SIMNETIQ
metaDescription: Comparing TextVerified with the SMS Code app by SIMNETIQ: US-only numbers with rentals on the web versus 100+ countries in a native iOS app.

hero.title: A TextVerified alternative with numbers in 100+ countries
intro: TextVerified is a US specialist. Their site is explicit about it: all their numbers are American, described as real US mobile numbers backed by physical SIMs, offered as one-time verifications or as short-term and renewable rentals through a web app, an API and a browser extension. When a sign-up specifically demands a +1 number, that focus is exactly what you want.

SMS Code by SIMNETIQ starts from the opposite premise: verification needs are international. It's a native iOS app with real numbers in 100+ countries — the US among them, but also Europe, Asia and beyond — covering 100+ popular services. Pick a service and country, get a number, and the code arrives in-app usually within seconds, paid for with one-time coin packs and cancelled free if no SMS shows up.

whenThem.title: When TextVerified is the better choice
whenThem.body: Choose TextVerified when the job is strictly American. Depth in a single market has real advantages: their site describes non-VoIP US numbers backed by physical SIMs, coverage of hundreds of services, and rental tiers — including renewable monthly rentals — for keeping a US number reachable over time. If you're verifying US-only platforms, need a +1 number that must pass carrier checks, or want a long-lived American number, a dedicated US service is the stronger tool.

whenUs.title: When the SMS Code app fits better
whenUs.body: Choose the app when one country isn't enough — or when the US isn't even the country you need. Plenty of services are cheaper or smoother to verify with a European or Asian number, and some aren't available to +1 numbers at all; with 100+ countries in one app you can simply pick whatever works best per sign-up. The experience is mobile-native from the App Store, billing is one-time coin packs through Apple with no subscription, and activations that receive nothing cancel free.

faqs.q: What's the biggest difference between TextVerified and the SMS Code app?
faqs.a: Geography. TextVerified's site states that all their numbers are US numbers — depth in one market. The SMS Code app by SIMNETIQ offers real numbers in 100+ countries through a native mobile app, so you choose the country per sign-up.

faqs.q: Does the SMS Code app have US numbers too?
faqs.a: Yes — the US is one of the 100+ countries available. The difference is that it's one option among many rather than the entire catalog.

faqs.q: Can I rent a number long-term like TextVerified's renewable rentals?
faqs.a: No. The app works per activation: one number, one service, one code. If you need a US number that stays reachable for weeks or months, TextVerified's rental tiers are honestly the better match.

faqs.q: What happens if my code never arrives?
faqs.a: The activation cancels and your coins are returned. You only pay for numbers that actually receive an SMS.

faqs.q: Is there a subscription in the SMS Code app?
faqs.a: No. You buy one-time coin packs through Apple billing and spend them per activation — nothing renews and no card details are shared with us.
